overview: A bilingual (Bengali/English) business website for Radha Madhav Mrit Shilpalay, a clay idol manufacturing and wholesale business in Bardhaman, West Bengal. Features a product-first homepage with sliding banner, featured products, admin panel with phone+password login, and full product/category management.
features: Phone+password admin login (no Internet Identity required)
Unified category management in admin panel
Product display on both Caffeine and Netlify
